title: JLPT N1 — Mastery & Nuance
description: High-register literary grammar, policy & editorial vocabulary, four-character idioms, and native rhetoric.

units.title: Literary & High-Register Grammar
units.subtitle: こうきゅうぶんぽう · Classical roots in modern formal Japanese

lessons.title: Necessity & Identity Patterns
lessons.objective: Master 〜ざるを得ない, 〜に他ならない, and 〜を踏まえて.
lessons.grammarNote: Many N1 structures preserve classical endings like ざる (negative) and つつ (ongoing).

example.term: 状況から判断して変更せざるを得ない。
example.transliteration: Joukyou kara handan shite henkou sezaru o enai.
example.translation: Judging from the situation, we have no choice but to change.

example.term: 上達は日々の努力の結果に他ならない。
example.transliteration: Joutatsu wa hibi no doryoku no kekka ni hoka naranai.
example.translation: Improvement is nothing other than the result of daily effort.

example.term: フィードバックを踏まえて改善した。
example.transliteration: Fiidobakku o fumaete kaizen shita.
example.translation: Improved based on feedback.

example.term: 学習環境は大きく変わりつつある。
example.transliteration: Gakushuu kankyou wa ookiku kawaritsutsu aru.
example.translation: The learning environment is gradually transforming.

example.term: 年齢や国籍を問わず利用できる。
example.transliteration: Nenrei ya kokuseki o towazu riyou dekiru.
example.translation: Usable regardless of age or nationality.

lessons.title: Extreme & Emphatic Structures
lessons.objective: Express strong emphasis with 〜極まりない and 〜に堪えない.
lessons.grammarNote: Classical intensifiers appear frequently in speeches, formal letters, and literary essays.

items.translation: On the occasion of / Prior to

example.term: 公開にあたって最終検証を行った。
example.transliteration: Koukai ni atatte saishuu kenshou o okonatta.
example.translation: Conducted final verification prior to release.

example.term: 本日をもって受付を終了します。
example.transliteration: Honjitsu o motte uketsuke o shuuryou shimasu.
example.translation: Applications close as of today.

example.term: 溢れんばかりの熱意が伝わった。
example.transliteration: Afuren bakari no netsui ga tsutawatta.
example.translation: Overflowing enthusiasm came across.

example.term: 地道に覚えるよりほかない。
example.transliteration: Jimichi ni oboeru yori hoka nai.
example.translation: There is no option other than steady memorization.

example.term: 設計思想からして合理的だ。
example.transliteration: Sekkei shisou kara shite gouriteki da.
example.translation: Even judging from its design philosophy, it's rational.

lessons.title: Concession & Qualification
lessons.objective: Handle subtle exceptions with 〜とはいえ and 〜ならまだしも.
lessons.grammarNote: 〜とはいえ ('although it is true that...') concedes a fact before stating a counterpoint.

items.translation: Although / Be that as it may

example.term: 初心者向けとはいえ奥が深い。
example.transliteration: Shoshinsha-muke to wa ie oku ga fukai.
example.translation: Although for beginners, it has real depth.

example.term: 制約にもかかわらず完成させた。
example.transliteration: Seiyaku ni mo kakawarazu kansei saseta.
example.translation: Completed notwithstanding the constraints.

example.term: 継続こそが最大の力だ。
example.transliteration: Keizoku koso ga saidai no chikara da.
example.translation: Consistency indeed is the greatest strength.

example.term: もし一から作り直すとしたらどうする。
example.transliteration: Moshi ichi kara tsukurinaosu to shitara dou suru.
example.translation: Supposing we rebuilt from scratch, what would you do?

items.translation: No need to go so far as to

example.term: 言うまでもなく復習が要だ。
example.transliteration: Iu made mo naku fukushuu ga kaname da.
example.translation: Needless to say, review is essential.

units.title: Policy, Editorial & Academic Discourse
units.subtitle: ろんひょうとしゃせつ · Newspaper editorials and critical analysis

lessons.title: Editorial Vocabulary
lessons.objective: Read newspaper editorials and thoughtful commentary.
lessons.grammarNote: Notice how abstract Kanji compounds pack rich conceptual nuance into 2–3 characters.

example.term: 学びの喜びは普遍的な価値だ。
example.transliteration: Manabi no yorokobi wa fuhenteki na kachi da.
example.translation: The joy of learning is a universal value.

example.term: プライバシーへの懸念を解消する。
example.transliteration: Puraibashii e no kenen o kaishou suru.
example.translation: Resolve concerns regarding privacy.

example.term: 鋭い洞察力が求められる。
example.transliteration: Surudoi dousatsuryoku ga motomerareru.
example.translation: Sharp insight is called for.

example.term: 持続可能なコミュニティを築く。
example.transliteration: Jizoku kanou na komyuniti o kizuku.
example.translation: Build a sustainable community.

example.term: その点には議論の余地がある。
example.transliteration: Sono ten ni wa giron no yochi ga aru.
example.translation: There is room for debate on that point.

lessons.title: Critical Analysis
lessons.objective: Evaluate logic, coherence, and underlying causes.
lessons.grammarNote: Use 検証 (verification) and 妥当性 (validity) in technical and academic writing.

example.term: 仮説を実験で検証した。
example.transliteration: Kasetsu o jikken de kenshou shita.
example.translation: Verified the hypothesis experimentally.

example.term: 設計の妥当性を確認する。
example.transliteration: Sekkei no datousei o kakunin suru.
example.translation: Confirm the soundness of the design.

example.term: 問題の本質を見極める。
example.transliteration: Mondai no honshitsu o mikiwameru.
example.translation: Discern the essence of the problem.

example.term: データ間の整合性を保つ。
example.transliteration: Deeta-kan no seigousei o tamotsu.
example.translation: Maintain consistency across data.

example.term: 多言語への展開を進める。
example.transliteration: Tagengo e no tenkai o susumeru.
example.translation: Advance the rollout to multiple languages.

lessons.title: Governance & Openness
lessons.objective: Discuss transparency, public benefit, and collaboration.
lessons.grammarNote: Terms like 透明性 (transparency) and 公益 (public interest) anchor policy and FOSS discourse.

example.term: オープンソースは透明性が高い。
example.transliteration: Oopunsoosu wa toumeisei ga takai.
example.translation: Open source has high transparency.

example.term: ユーザーとの共創で教材を磨く。
example.transliteration: Yuuzaa to no kyousou de kyouzai o migaku.
example.translation: Polish learning materials through co-creation with users.

example.term: 明確な規範を設ける。
example.transliteration: Meikaku na kihan o moukeru.
example.translation: Establish clear standards.

example.term: 自主的な学びを支援する。
example.transliteration: Jishuteki na manabi o shien suru.
example.translation: Support autonomous learning.

example.term: 新しい習慣が徐々に浸透した。
example.transliteration: Atarashii shuukan ga jojo ni shintou shita.
example.translation: The new habit gradually took hold.

units.title: Four-Character Idioms & Proverbs
units.subtitle: よじじゅくごとことわざ · Classic cultural idioms (Yojijukugo)

lessons.title: Yojijukugo: Growth & Effort
lessons.objective: Master classic four-character idioms about learning and perseverance.
lessons.grammarNote: Break each 四字熟語 into two 2-kanji halves to decode its imagery easily.

example.term: 試行錯誤を重ねて完成させた。
example.transliteration: Shikou sakugo o kasanete kansei saseta.
example.translation: Completed through repeated trial and error.

example.term: 仲間と切磋琢磨して成長する。
example.transliteration: Nakama to sessa takuma shite seichou suru.
example.translation: Grow by motivating and sharpening each other.

items.translation: Gaining new wisdom from the past

example.term: 温故知新の精神で設計する。
example.transliteration: Onko chishin no seishin de sekkei suru.
example.translation: Design in the spirit of learning from the past.

example.term: 初志貫徹で最後までやり抜く。
example.transliteration: Shoshi kantetsu de saigo made yarinuku.
example.translation: Carry out one's original resolve to the end.

items.reading: けいぞくはちからなり

example.term: 語学学習は継続は力なりだ。
example.transliteration: Gogaku gakushuu wa keizoku wa chikara nari da.
example.translation: In language learning, perseverance is power.

lessons.title: Yojijukugo: Wisdom & Perspective
lessons.objective: Understand famous idioms heard in speeches and literature.
lessons.grammarNote: Idioms like 一期一会 reflect core Japanese cultural values.

example.term: 人との出会いは一期一会だ。
example.transliteration: Hito to no deai wa ichigo ichie da.
example.translation: Every encounter is once in a lifetime.

example.term: 耳で学ぶのは一石二鳥だ。
example.transliteration: Mimi de manabu no wa isseki nichou da.
example.translation: Learning by ear kills two birds with one stone.

example.term: 学び方は十人十色だ。
example.transliteration: Manabikata wa juunin toiro da.
example.translation: Ways of learning differ from person to person.

example.term: 言葉がなくても以心伝心だ。
example.transliteration: Kotoba ga nakute mo ishin denshin da.
example.translation: Mutual understanding even without words.

items.reading: ひゃくぶんはいっけんにしかず

example.term: まずは使ってみよう。百聞は一見に如かず。
example.transliteration: Mazu wa tsukatte miyou. Hyakubun wa ikken ni shikazu.
example.translation: Try it first—seeing is believing.

lessons.title: Everyday Cultural Proverbs
lessons.objective: Recognize proverbs woven into natural native conversation.
lessons.grammarNote: Many Japanese proverbs use vivid nature or daily-life metaphors.

items.translation: Fall seven times, get up eight

example.term: 七転び八起きで挑戦し続ける。
example.transliteration: Nanakorobi yaoki de chousen shi tsuzukeru.
example.translation: Keep challenging yourself—fall seven times, rise eight.

items.term: 塵も積もれば山となる
items.reading: ちりもつもればやまとなる
items.transliteration: chiri mo tsumoreba yama to naru

example.term: 一日五語でも塵も積もれば山となる。
example.transliteration: Ichinichi go-go demo chiri mo tsumoreba yama to naru.
example.translation: Even five words a day build a mountain.

example.term: 誰にでもミスはある。猿も木から落ちる。
example.transliteration: Dare ni demo misu wa aru. Saru mo ki kara ochiru.
example.translation: Everyone slips—even monkeys fall from trees.

example.term: 基礎を固めよう。急がば回れだ。
example.transliteration: Kiso o katameyou. Isogaba maware da.
example.translation: Solidify the basics—taking the steady way is faster.

items.term: 言うは易く行うは難し
items.reading: いうはやすくおこなうはかたし
items.transliteration: iu wa yasuku okonau wa katashi

example.term: 理想は高いが言うは易く行うは難しだ。
example.transliteration: Risou wa takai ga iu wa yasuku okonau wa katashi da.
example.translation: High ideals are easier said than done.

units.title: Native Rhetoric & Precision
units.subtitle: れとりっくとひょうげん · Subtlety, understatement, and style

lessons.title: Nuanced Qualification
lessons.objective: Avoid overgeneralization with precise rhetorical hedges.
lessons.grammarNote: Expressions like とは限らない and 一概には言えない are hallmarks of mature Japanese.

example.term: 高価な教材が最良とは限らない。
example.transliteration: Kouka na kyouzai ga sairyou to wa kagiranai.
example.translation: Expensive materials are not necessarily best.

items.reading: いちがいにはいえない

example.term: どちらが優れているか一概には言えない。
example.transliteration: Dochira ga sugurete iru ka ichigai ni wa ienai.
example.translation: One cannot generalize which is superior.

example.term: この構造は極めて明快だ。
example.transliteration: Kono kouzou wa kiwamete meikai da.
example.translation: This structure is exceedingly clear.

example.term: 完成した。もっとも改善の余地はある。
example.transliteration: Kansei shita. Mottomo kaizen no yochi wa aru.
example.translation: It's done—admittedly there's room to improve.

example.term: 大局的な視点で判断する。
example.transliteration: Taikyokuteki na shiten de handan suru.
example.translation: Judge from a big-picture perspective.

lessons.title: Craft & Refinement
lessons.objective: Describe elegance, subtlety, and mastery of expression.
lessons.grammarNote: Notice aesthetic adjectives like 洗練された (refined) and 簡潔 (concise).

example.term: 洗練されたインターフェース。
example.transliteration: Senren sareta intaafeesu.
example.translation: A refined interface.

example.term: 簡潔で分かりやすい説明。
example.transliteration: Kanketsu de wakariyasui setsumei.
example.translation: A concise and clear explanation.

example.term: 日本語の敬語には深い妙味がある。
example.transliteration: Nihongo no keigo ni wa fukai myoumi ga aru.
example.translation: Japanese honorifics have a deep, subtle charm.

items.translation: To master completely / reach the peak

example.term: 一つの道を極めるのは尊い。
example.transliteration: Hitotsu no michi o kiwameru no wa toutoi.
example.translation: Mastering a single craft is noble.

example.term: 軽さと自由さこそがこのアプリの真骨頂だ。
example.transliteration: Karusa to jiyuusa koso ga kono apuri no shinkotchou da.
example.translation: Lightness and freedom are the true essence of this app.

lessons.title: Persuasive Discourse
lessons.objective: Conclude arguments cleanly in speeches and essays.
lessons.grammarNote: Use 要するに (in essence) and 翻って (looking back from another angle) to guide readers.

example.term: 要するに、誰でも学べる場を作りたい。
example.transliteration: Yousuru ni, dare demo manaberu ba o tsukuritai.
example.translation: In essence, we want to build a place where anyone can learn.

example.term: 仮に圏外でも学習を続けられる。
example.transliteration: Kari ni kengai demo gakushuu o tsuzukerareru.
example.translation: Even supposing you have no signal, you can keep learning.

example.term: ファイル保存、あるいはテキストコピーで移行できる。
example.transliteration: Fairu hozon, aruiwa tekisuto kopii de ikou dekiru.
example.translation: Migrate via file save or alternatively text copy.

items.translation: To think through to the core

example.term: 使いやすさを突き詰めた結果だ。
example.transliteration: Tsukaiyasusa o tsukitsumeta kekka da.
example.translation: It's the result of pursuing usability to its core.

example.term: N1まで走り抜いた達成感は格別だ。
example.transliteration: N1 made hashirinuita tasseikan wa kakubetsu da.
example.translation: The sense of accomplishment reaching N1 is extraordinary.
